source_review.observation: Estimated base pose through default_sense(seed=17); physical contacts used only in scoring.
source_review.release: At 5.2 s, evaluate one feet-only solve; accept projected status; issue a second feet-only solve. These are separate commands, and both solve costs contribute to transition latency.
source_review.abort: Rejection branch sets the current estimated state as rest reference and adds the existing weight-100 velocity cost. No rejection occurred; no abort validation is claimed.
source_review.schedule: Both feet remain fixed throughout; feet-only return excludes subsequent gripper contacts. Original site membership and certified defaults unchanged.
source_review.shutdown: Final command at 9.02 s is replaced by shutdown without plant integration; scored force phases end before 9 s.

visual_review.nominal: Standing return visible at 6.5, 8 and 9 s; hands separate from the tabletop.
visual_review.pulse: Torso remains inclined and hands near the table at 6.5, 8 and 9 s; body load logs establish renewed support.
visual_review.limitation: Eight-frame sequences do not resolve millimetre foot slip; raw motion logs determine that measurement.

decision: First-command release feasibility fails to predict successful disturbed recovery. Keep opt-in; no further rollout is required for this hypothesis.
